note: A 429 from the /api/* limiter (default 50 requests per 10 s per IP). Not provoked. Shape from PeerTube develop server/core/middlewares/rate-limiter.ts (sendRateLimited: res.status(options.statusCode).send(options.message)) with express-rate-limit 8.7 defaults (statusCode 429, message "Too many requests, please try again later.", legacy X-RateLimit-* headers, Retry-After in whole seconds until the window resets). The body is plain text sent with res.send, so Express labels it text/html. Header values are illustrative.
